standard_prerequisites.use: The chapter lemmas that etale morphisms of algebraic spaces are formally etale (representable-property-formally-property), that formal smoothness composes with formal etaleness (composition-formally-smooth-etale-unramified) and the formal permanence criterion (lemma-formally-permanence); cited inputs with the chain written in the retained span.

core_obligations: Deduce U -> X and V -> Y formally etale from the helper lemma.
Compose to obtain U -> Y formally smooth.
Apply the formal permanence lemma to conclude psi formally smooth.

proof_roadmap.step: Convert etale vertical arrows into formal etaleness and compose.
Descend formal smoothness to psi via the permanence lemma.

difficulty_reason: In a commutative diagram of morphisms of algebraic spaces over S with etale vertical arrows U -> X and V -> Y, if f : X -> Y is formally smooth then psi : U -> V is formally smooth. The retained proof is a written three-lemma chain: the representability helper lemma makes U -> X and V -> Y formally etale, the composition lemma gives formal smoothness of U -> Y, and the formal permanence lemma descends smoothness to psi along the formally etale V -> Y. Retained author proof at lines 4567-4575.
